en.note: Reference case. Dark and Darker wipes its player market every season, so this is a holdout evaluation on Season 10 data (Jul 17 – Oct 9, 2026), not a live forecast.

stats.label: Holdout
stats.hint: 505 hours · model refit daily, 24 h ahead

fig1.title: Cobalt Ore, Season 10 — 21-day holdout: actual vs. 24-hour-ahead forecast
fig1.sub: Sep 18 – Oct 9, 2026 · hourly median price · ensemble (HGB + RF + ARIMA) refit every day, forecasting the next 24 h · band = 90% empirical interval · last training week shown for context
fig1.caption: Exhibit 1. Over 505 held-out hours the ensemble beat “same as last hour” by 9.2% on MAE (8.07 vs 8.90) and called the direction of the next hour right 64% of the time. The 90% interval covered only 61% of actuals — the jump on Sep 18–20 shows why: intervals learned on calmer weeks are too narrow when the market moves.

fig2.title: Day by day: skill against naive, and interval coverage
fig2.sub: bar = 1 − MAE / MAE_naive for each 24-hour window (positive = beats naive) · dot = share of that day’s hours inside the 90% interval
fig2.caption: Exhibit 2. The model wins on 11 of 21 days and loses clearly on four when the price jumped (Sep 22, 26, 29, Oct 5). Coverage follows volatility: close to 90% in the calm first week of October, under 30% on jump days — the intervals need to scale with the price level.

fig3.title: The pipeline, with its numbers
fig3.caption: Exhibit 3. Baselines run first; a model is used only when the rolling backtest says it beats them, and the holdout checks that claim on data the selection never saw.

zh.note: 案例参考。《Dark and Darker》每个赛季都会清空玩家市场，因此这是在第 10 赛季数据（2026-07-17 至 10-09）上做的留出评估，不是实时行情。

stats.label: 留出评估
stats.hint: 505 小时 · 每日重训、预测未来 24 小时

fig1.title: 钴矿 · 第 10 赛季——21 天留出评估：实际值与提前 24 小时的预测
fig1.sub: 2026-09-18 至 10-09 · 小时中位价 · 集成模型（HGB + RF + ARIMA）每日重训、预测未来 24 小时 · 着色 = 90% 经验区间 · 左侧为训练集最后一周
fig1.caption: 图 1. 在 505 个留出小时上，集成模型的 MAE 比“沿用上一小时”低 9.2%（8.07 对 8.90），下一小时涨跌方向判对 64%。90% 区间只覆盖了 61% 的实际值——9 月 18–20 日的跳涨说明了原因：在平静周学到的区间，遇到行情波动就太窄。

fig2.title: 逐日：相对基准的 skill，以及区间覆盖率
fig2.sub: 条 = 每个 24 小时窗口的 1 − MAE / MAE_naive（正值 = 胜过基准）· 点 = 当日落在 90% 区间内的小时占比
fig2.caption: 图 2. 21 天里模型赢了 11 天，在价格跳变的 4 天明显输（9 月 22、26、29 日和 10 月 5 日）。覆盖率跟着波动走：10 月第一周行情平静时接近 90%，跳变日不到 30%——区间需要随价格水平缩放。

fig3.title: 管道各环节及其数字
fig3.caption: 图 3. 基准先跑；只有滚动回测证明模型更准才启用模型，留出集再用选择时没见过的数据核对这个结论。
